text: The updater records timestamps after fetch, JSON parsing and synchronous return from onUpdate; it does not await a Promise returned by that callback, keeps the last quota-sized set, and schedules from the oldest timestamp when the rolling window is full. Failed fetches return before adding history. Preserve this actual update accounting; the source comment saying notifications have been shown does not describe what the quota counts. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Define notification update quota as a rolling successful-update window
